tldr: Lilith in Sagittarius: the wild truth-teller and the refusal of dogma
body: Lilith in Sagittarius: the wild truth-teller and the refusal of dogma. Where you reclaim your own meaning and freedom. Watch: righteous excess.
business: Owned, this is the nerve to live by your own truth.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes restless discontent; unchecked, preachy dogma or flight from commitment.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
